tasks.subject: Task 1: TransmitMode enum + denoise()
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add the `TransmitMode` enum and a denoise-only path on `TransmitProcessor` (suppressor per 10 ms sub-frame, no VAD, no gate) for the PTT held-audio path.

**Files:**
- Create: `app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/TransmitMode.kt`
- Modify: `app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/TransmitProcessor.kt`
- Test: `app/src/test/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/TransmitProcessorTest.kt`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `TransmitMode` enum with `VOICE_ACTIVATED` and `PUSH_TO_TALK`.
- [ ] `TransmitProcessor.denoise(capturePcm)` runs the suppressor once per 10 ms sub-frame; no gate.
- [ ] Test proves suppressor offsets `0` and `FRAME_SAMPLES_10MS`, gate stays closed.

**Verify:** `export JAVA_HOME="/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home"; ./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests "me.danielstiner.dumble.mumble.voice.TransmitProcessorTest"` → BUILD SUCCESSFUL.

**Steps:** See plan §Task 1. Create enum; add failing denoise test; add denoise(); pass; commit.

tasks.subject: Task 2: Engine push-to-talk transmit logic
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Make `AudioVoiceEngine.nextOutgoingFrame()` honor `TransmitMode`: VA unchanged; PTT denoises and transmits only while `pttHeld`, gate bypassed, one silent terminator on release and on a live mode switch.

**Files:**
- Modify: `app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/AudioVoiceEngine.kt`
- Test: `app/src/test/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/AudioVoiceEngineTransmitModeTest.kt` (new)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `initialTransmitMode` ctor param; `setTransmitMode(mode)` + `setPttHeld(value)`.
- [ ] PTT not held → `null`.
- [ ] PTT held → one non-terminator frame per capture.
- [ ] PTT release edge → exactly one terminator (`length>0`), then `null`.
- [ ] Mid-transmit mode switch → one closing terminator.
- [ ] Existing `AudioVoiceEngineFrameNumberTest` still passes.

**Verify:** `export JAVA_HOME="/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home"; ./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests "me.danielstiner.dumble.mumble.voice.AudioVoiceEngine*"` → BUILD SUCCESSFUL.

**Steps:** See plan §Task 2. Add 4 PTT tests; add mode fields/setters (pendingClose, pttWasSending, sending); rewrite nextOutgoingFrame with terminatorFrame/encodeAndCount helpers; full engine suite green; commit.

tasks.subject: Task 3: MumbleManager transmit-mode wiring
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Persisted `transmitMode` StateFlow on `MumbleManager` (mirrors `vadThreshold`), transient `setPttHeld`, construct engine with loaded mode, clear self-mute on switch to PTT.

**Files:**
- Modify: `app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/MumbleManager.kt`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `transmitMode: StateFlow<TransmitMode>`, default VA, loaded from `dumble_audio`/`transmit_mode` in `init()`.
- [ ] `setTransmitMode(mode)` persists + forwards + `setMuted(false)` on PUSH_TO_TALK.
- [ ] `setPttHeld(held)` forwards (not persisted).
- [ ] Engine constructed with `initialTransmitMode = _transmitMode.value`.
- [ ] `compileDebugKotlin` succeeds.

**Verify:** `export JAVA_HOME="/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home"; ./gradlew :app:compileDebugKotlin` → BUILD SUCCESSFUL.

tasks.subject: Task 4: UI selector + PTT button + wiring
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Expose the transmit mode in the UI end-to-end — a mode selector in Settings, a hold-to-talk button that replaces Mute in the call screen (PTT mode), and the DumbleApp wiring connecting both to MumbleManager. (Merged from original Tasks 4-6: Kotlin compiles the whole module, so the screen-signature changes and the DumbleApp call-site updates MUST land together.)

**Files:**
- Modify: `app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/ui/SettingsScreen.kt`
- Modify: `app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/ui/ActiveCallScreen.kt`
- Modify: `app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/ui/DumbleApp.kt`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] SettingsScreen: `transmitMode` + `onTransmitModeChange` params; radio selector Voice activity | Push to talk; slider enabled only in VA with PTT note.
- [ ] ActiveCallScreen: `transmitMode`/`onPttPress`/`onPttRelease` params; Mute chip only in VA, hold-to-talk button only in PTT (press/release via detectTapGestures+tryAwaitRelease).
- [ ] DumbleApp collects `MumbleManager.transmitMode`; wires SettingsScreen (onTransmitModeChange->setTransmitMode) and ActiveCallScreen (onPttPress/onPttRelease->setPttHeld).
- [ ] @Previews updated; assembleDebug + full unit-test suite green.

**Verify:** `export JAVA_HOME="/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home"; ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug :app:testDebugUnitTest` -> BUILD SUCCESSFUL, all tests pass.

**Steps:** Apply plan Task 4 (SettingsScreen selector), Task 5 (ActiveCallScreen PushToTalkButton + Mute-replacement), Task 6 (DumbleApp collect + wire both call sites) together in one commit. Full verbatim code in the plan doc.
